author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
EDIT: Allegedly, he now has a final official warning. This is not fair to me considering the grief he has caused, and if he's a liability I would still encourage a demotion. There needs to be an example set for the other referees that strikes in this severity can't just be treated the same and ignored. He is down to the core now, and there's no reason to keep him. As a rule of thumb, if he's done more reckless bad than good or at least a form of "chaotic good", it's time to let go.

It is with a heavy heart that I file a complaint against a staff member in this fashion for the first time since 2015, specifically against LythureIsBack who is a referee and a part of the event staff. I would like to involve the administrators who are officials that have access to this forum, and I give permissible access to any other officials and trusted individuals who want to see this post, and to detail the post in specific including context, quotes, and evidence.

As a preface, I am heavily disappointed with the conduct of this referee. This referee has not proved to meet the basic morals & standards of being a representative of the team. He has consistently proven since after the tournament that he is not fit for the rank, and that I request his rank be terminated immediately. I have been interested in the growth of the event team since being in the tournament committee back in 2014, and an official until 2015: however, this is probably the most deplorable situation I've seen where a staff member can get away with so much and not face repercussions.

First of all, I'm going to start with something easy that is, quite blatantly, an open-and-shut case:


This was said publicly in Discord by Lythure, whom not only has the referee color backing him, but insists on telling an extremely offensive and insensitive joke with no humor value, but rather shock value. Also, as being a staff member since late 2013, this was (excluding Zachary and Michael) the worst thing I've ever heard said on the server. This alone, if held to any basic standard, would be an immediate demotion. It's a disgusting hit and a low-blow, and comparing human lives to actual lasagna and planting/becoming meat, is by far a mentally disturbed cry for "I need to see a psychiatrist".

Second of all, which is the most notorious: he has made a lot of posts that outline very disrespectful comments, as well as ones that either contradict, admit he does not know the most controversial tournament rule, telling a former admin/oldest user that their mistake was donating to the tournament, or literally digging the officials into a deeper hole. Regardless of if he is defending you or not, he is making all of the officials be cast in an extremely bad light and according to many sources, proves the community's point. This should be handled immediately and his posts archived. I am sure you've read the thread, but if not: https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/f637de53c

Note that your referee actually convinced someone who is the longest standing supporter of the server to not donate anymore.


Not only these two points, however I'd like to say how poorly received this referee is. He has become a laughingstock and no community member has endorsed his behavior: staff members have turned against his rebelous behaviour, and have also complained about him. There should be no reward for how all of this panned out, and that means stripping his rank, because this is quite frankly, ridiculous.

Thank you for reading and evaluating this post,
Vice
